commit.message:
test(memory): count a real Windows refusal of the lock put-back as a retry, not a failure

The put-back test injected two EPERM refusals and asserted exactly three
attempts, but on a real Windows host the third, real rename can be refused
too while the third writer holds the lock open, and restoreLock retries it.
Assert three as the floor.

Closes #5683
